classProgression.intro: Once you meet every requirement, you can choose one of the following promotion paths. Each develops your class in a different direction and helps shape the next chapters of your adventure.
classProgression.noPromotions: No promotion is currently defined for your class.

descriptions.warrior: The offensive Fighter branch for front-line combat. It focuses on strength, weapons, and bringing enemies down quickly.
descriptions.knight: The defensive Fighter branch for front-line combat. It relies on shields, resilience, and protecting allies.
descriptions.ranger: A ranged combatant focused on bows and polearms.

actions.noneDescription: No action will be assigned to this button.
actions.autoAttackDescription: Your character automatically attacks the selected target while it is in range.
actions.powerStrikeDescription: A fast, powerful weapon strike – {bonus}% bonus attack.
actions.preciseShotDescription: A shot that always lands as a perfect hit – {bonus}% bonus attack.
actions.healDescription: Use a bandage to heal yourself. If you are not injured and another character is selected, the bandage is used on them.
actions.healingPotionDescription: Use a health potion from inventory when injured. The strongest available potion is always used.
actions.manaPotionDescription: Use a mana potion from inventory when mana is not full. The strongest available potion is always used.
actions.staminaPotionDescription: Use a stamina potion from inventory when stamina is not full. The strongest available potion is always used.
actions.equipStoredWeaponsDescription: Switch between primary and secondary stored weapon. If you are holding a completely different weapon, the primary one will be equipped.
actions.campingDescription: Try to light a fire if it's possible in this place and you have some wood in inventory. You can rest and cook food on the fire.
actions.restingDescription: The character rests by the fire.

categoryInfo.potions: Brewing potions and elixirs from herbs and other ingredients.
categoryInfo.oreSmelting: Smelting purifies ore into ingots used to craft weapons and armor. Rarer metals require special purifying additives.
categoryInfo.woodProcessing: Process logs into planks for crafting bows, staves and wands. Rarer woods require purifying additives.
categoryInfo.leatherProcessing: Process raw hides into leather for crafting leather armor. Rarer hides require purifying additives.
categoryInfo.resources: Crafting useful resources and materials that are often needed for further crafting.
categoryInfo.npcHelp: {npc} will help you craft the simplest ones.
